usage: tunnel check [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] [-q K=V] [-d BODY] method url

positional arguments:
  method           HTTP method, e.g. GET
  url              the full URL, e.g. https://api.example.com/api/feed

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --base BASE      where the admin API answers (default http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json           print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
  -q, --query K=V  query parameter, repeatable
  -d, --data BODY  request body: literal JSON, @file, or plain text
